punchline: The man trapped in a post office doorway was not stupid, the door was badly designed, says Don Norman.
thirty_sec: Don Norman opens his book with a friend who was trapped in the doorway of a post office in a European city. His verdict is that the door was at fault. A flat plate says push and a vertical handle says pull. He applies the same logic to a stove with burners in a square and controls in a row. If a mistake repeats, look at the setup.
